facts.value: If the indexed p_link/s_link anchor is non-null, scans the owner and preceding GObjs and stops at the first process encountered with the same s_link. It updates the indexed anchor if that predecessor was the old anchor. An empty group installs the new anchor immediately. Without such a predecessor, scans lower p_link anchors; without any predecessor, installs the global s_link head. It prepends the owner child chain and adjusts the pending scheduler cursor only when b0 is set and both saved neighbors and s_link match.
facts.rationale: State the exact search/initialization sequence and retain deferred-removal limits.

evidence.why: Shows the precise branch and update sequence.

facts.value: Requests removal of every process in an HSD_GObj owner chain, saving each child pointer before invoking the single-record remover. Ordinary records are detached and freed; the currently executing record can remain linked with removal pending. Generic GObj destruction calls this cleanup before freeing the owner.

facts.value: Detaches the global schedule links while preserving owner-chain membership and allocation. Advances HSD_GObj_804D7830 only when b0 is set and that cursor equals the removed record; the runner sets b0 while draining deferred operations after callback return. Repairs the bucket anchor and neighboring links without clearing the removed record's own prev/next fields.
facts.rationale: b0 guards deferred-operation draining, not ordinary callback execution; describe the literal guard.

evidence.why: Shows guarded cursor repair and scheduler-only unlink.
Shows b0 set during deferred-operation drain.

facts.value: Detaches a registered process without freeing its storage. Delegated global unlink repairs the scheduler links and indexed anchor; it advances the pending cursor only when b0 is set and that cursor names this process. Owner unlink changes either gobj->proc or a predecessor child pointer. The owner chain must contain the record; there is no null or membership guard.
facts.rationale: TU synthesis narrows cursor repair to the literal b0 drain-phase guard in the delegated unlink.

evidence.why: Shows the guarded cursor update and following owner-chain unlink.
